_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Chemical Accident or Incident Report
summary: Describes specific information applicable to an accident or incident involving chemical agents, used to determine the extent of the accident or incident.
description_purpose:
3.1 The Chemical Accident or Incident Report describes specific information applicable to an accident or incident involving chemical agents.

3.2 This report is used to determine the extent of the accident or incident involving chemical agents.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

7.2 This report is a requirement for contractors engaged in research, development, test and evaluation, production, or maintenance work which requires the use of chemical agents or dilute solutions of chemical agents.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Chemical Accident or Incident Report shall be in a contractor selected format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Chemical Accident or Incident Report content shall be as follows:

children.title: Date and time of the accident or incident.
Location of the accident or incident.
Quantity and type of weapon(s) or container(s), and chemical agent(s).
Description of property damage and personnel casualties.
Type of carrier (if one involved).
Type of operation (i.e., laboratory analysis, surveillance testing, logistical movement, storage inspection, alert, maintenance, renovation, demilitarization, disposal).
Description of the accident or incident.
Whether a weapon or container burned, detonated (to what degree), or was exposed to fire.
Details of any existing chemical hazard or contamination, or explanation of circumstance/conditions requiring emergency disposal.
Condition of chemical weapon or container, including fuzing (if applicable).
Whether a news release was given to the media.
children.content: If so, include a copy of the news release.

children.title: Measures taken to ensure safety and security.

Any other pertinent information, including cause factors, if know, decision-making process for determining the necessary corrective or emergency action (plus alternatives considered), and any possible political implications.
State corrective actions recommended, or method of disposal and earliest date which disposal will be accomplished, if appropriate.
Assistance required (i.e., Augmentation Force (AF), Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD)).

preparation_instructions.title: Malfunction
preparation_instructions.content: If a malfunction of equipment is involved, the report shall contain the following information:

children.title: Equipment nomenclature.
Quantity involved.
Production lot number(s).
Brief technical description of malfunction.

preparation_instructions.title: Emergency Destruction
preparation_instructions.content: If the report addresses the emergency destruction of hazardous munitions, the report shall include the following:

children.title: Type of air samplers used and results obtained.
